plans.sql: select "trades_0".trade_id as "trade_id", "trades_0".region as "region", "trades_0".notional as "notional" from (select "trades_1".trade_id as trade_id, "trades_1".customer_id as customer_id, "trades_1".region as region, "trades_1".notional as notional from trades as "trades_1") as "trades_0"
select "customers_0".id as "id", "customers_0".name as "name" from (select "customers_1".id as id, "customers_1".name as name from customers as "customers_1") as "customers_0"

select "customers_0"."name" as "name" from (select "trades_1".trade_id as trade_id, "trades_1".customer_id as customer_id, "trades_1".region as region, "trades_1".notional as notional from trades as "trades_1") as "trades_0" left outer join (select "customers_1".id as "id", "customers_1".name as "name" from (select "customers_2".id as id, "customers_2".name as name from customers as "customers_2") as "customers_1") as "customers_0" on ("customers_0"."id" = "trades_0"."customer_id")

select "trades_0"."notional" as "notional" from (select "customers_1".id as id, "customers_1".name as name from customers as "customers_1") as "customers_0" left outer join (select "trades_1".trade_id as "trade_id", "trades_1".customer_id as "customer_id", "trades_1".region as "region", "trades_1".notional as "notional" from (select "trades_2".trade_id as trade_id, "trades_2".customer_id as customer_id, "trades_2".region as region, "trades_2".notional as notional from trades as "trades_2") as "trades_1") as "trades_0" on ("customers_0"."id" = "trades_0"."customer_id")
